About Us

Every outing should feel like a getaway. That’s why we’re dedicated to providing a seamless rental experience and a comfortable space for you to unwind, celebrate, or explore.

Exclusively on Lake Norman

Your on the water experience happens right here only on Lake Norman. We operate solely on Charlotte’s premier lake, giving you a dedicated, local experience every time. No extra locations, no confusion just smooth, reliable fun on the water where it matters most.

Where Good Times Set Sail

Clean, comfortable, and ready to go. Our fleet is designed for easy cruising, celebrations,and everything in between. With spacious layouts, Bluetooth sound, and shaded seating, you'll feel right at home just with a better view.
